items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: she took me to hear Slim and Slam. And I sat in and played with them. Then they hired me, added me to their trio -- made a trio out of it. And I played for them quite a while.

ctx.x: money -- I didn't have any money. I was working by then... The drummer had gotten himself a job, and he had a five-piece band, and I was in it. And Claire used to come over to where... I was staying at his house then; I'd moved in with him. And she used to come and take me, and she took me around to different places -- and she took me to hear Slim and Slam. And I sat in and played with them. Then they hired me, added me to their trio -- made a trio out of it. And I played for them quite a while.
